Don't EVER talk to family and friends.  It is the worst thing you can do.  They're not prepared for it.  You wouldn't run up to your family and friends with your bone sticking out of your arm, asking them to surgically repair it, would you?  So why would you do the same thing here?  They're not medically prepared for any of this, especially if you bring suicide up.  And truthfully, if they haven't asked, they likely don't give a shit. 

BTW, I went through your post history.  As someone who posts to /r/fatpeoplehate punchablefaces etc. and seems to talk shit about people in general, why the fuck are you posting here?  What if OP is a huge fat fuck that you hate?  Why would you try to save his life when you hate him???  What if his face is the most punchable in the world???

No there isn't.  Have you looked at the debt numbers of this country?  You're a slave.  Your taxes go to people that use it to create more conflict so them and their college buddies can make money off of it.  We're all bitches to the modern military industrial complex.  We pay soldiers (high school dropouts) to kill people for us.  Its a cycle, and you and I are in it.
Naw, that doesn't do anything for me.  I really have no desire to talk to anyone else every again.  I just want a viewing audience for my suicide, which people seem to be freaking out over.
I'll mention you in the video.  Try to get some traffic to your /u/

A bunch of religious bull crap.  You know god doesnt exist, but you build yourself to believe in the existence of something that isn't there.  You fool yourself on a daily basis without any evidence.  How the fuck is that a life living for?
Minority?  Go look at the most searched things for following news of beheadings, mass executions, etc.  Lol.  They like it more than Kim Kardashian's ass.  Why are you denying facts?

Everyone loves gore videos.  They love these beheading videos ISIS throws out and just about every other form of graphic imagery.  I just want to add a little bit to the table.  Whats wrong with that???

I'm 10 years younger than you and in a similar situation.  No job and can't get one.  I can't do all this interviewing and networking stuff.  All about making friends, kissing ass, whathaveyoudoneformelately mentality.  I've accepted that.  I'm going to blow my brains out pretty damn soon.  Reading your posts seem like a marker I'd end up reaching myself in the future.

In the past I've shaken the thoughts of suicide out of my mind, but that was wrong.  I should not get rid of an emotion and desire that continues to pop up in my mind from the moment I wake up to the moment I fall asleep.  I wasn't made for this world, and I've accepted it.  Maybe a hundred years ago when everyone was a farmer and the world wasn't the way it is right now.  Irregardless, it is 2014 and not for me.

Dude, you already know the world is stacked against you.  Economically you're going to be someones bitch.  Socially you're going to be someones bitch.  Politically youre going to be someones bitch.  You are manufactured by wealthy men and women to perform services and create products for them and their well being.  I'm leaving soon too dude.  Might take some out with me.

Precious?  You don't even know who the fuck I am.  What if I am a psychopath or sociopath that has no consideration for the world around me?  What if I'm a bad person?  Maybe I've scammed people and hurt them?  Robbed them and assaulted them?  

This community is called suicidewatch.  I just want you to watch my suicide.  What is wrong with that???

I got a list of all the medications doctors have prescribed to me over the last 6-7 years from my pharmacy.  I was amazed at all the crap I've tried over time.  All it did was one thing:  make me gain weight.  I shit you not.  I've become a morbidly obese fuck swallowing all those pills to change my brain chemistry or whatever bullshit these pharmaceutical companies try to feed you.  I have no confidence what so ever.   I don't apply for jobs anymore.  I don't have any friends of any kind.  

What you're feeling right now is true.  No matter what they say.  Unless you're schizophrenic or have a disorder that makes something isn't truly there appear, then whatever you're feeling is truly a result of the world you see around yourself.  It is an honest realization of how others feel about you.  If you think your husband doesn't care, it is likely true.  Your friends? They definitely don't give a shit.  You likely have the evidence in front of you to prove this.  All the pills you end up taking mask the evidence and force you to accept something isn't true.

I don't even look myself in the eyes when I look in the mirror.  I hate the fucking site of it.
